steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: The best that I can say is, it's not getting worse. Yet.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hm... Well, I suppose there isn't anything that can be done about it.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Compared to your situation, Popukar's numbers look pretty optimistic.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Although not so optimistic that we can stop monitoring her.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: That said, she's doing the right thing by going to bed early and getting up early in the morning. You could learn a thing or two from her.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: She has spent virtually her entire life living with Oripathy...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Maybe that's a blessing, in a sense.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The other day, I was reading a magazine with Popukar, and she said she hoped I could design clothes for her to wear when she grows up.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Will I get to see that day, though?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Try not to let that weigh on your mind.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Both for the sake of your condition... and her.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: *sigh*.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Dr. Li! I finished the coloring book you gave me! Do you have another?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: So quick, Popukar? You're good.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I did it with Bubble!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: We even drew ourselves drawing in the blank spaces.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Both of you are really good.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Here, I've got another coloring book.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Thank you, Doctor!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Bubble! I got a new coloring book!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: She's not in the game room?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I guess I'll wait for her to come back.

steps.name: Boy in Patient Gown
steps.text: Did you sneak out from the wards too? I don't think I've seen you before.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh? Who are you?

steps.name: Boy in Patient Gown
steps.text: I'm Elwin. What is this place? There are so many toys everywhere.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'm Popukar. This is the Rhodes Island game room.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Are you lost? I can take you back.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: No. Ever since I got here, I’ve just been stuck in the ward. They won’t let me go out to play. What's that in your hand?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: A coloring book. Dr. Li gave it to me.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You wanna do it with me?

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: I've never done one before. Is that okay?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Dr. Li says the point of coloring is to have fun. We can draw whatever we want, as long as we don't get the table dirty.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: This is Felitubby, this is Littlemon, and there are a bunch of empty spaces where Bubble and I draw the folks of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh, Bubble is my friend. She was here just now, but I don't know where she went.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Here, crayons. I always start with the brightest color.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Which one is the brightest?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Digs through the crayons)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: This one! This red's really bright. I like it a lot.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: This crayon’s nearly got no tip left.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I use it a lot because it's nice!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's short because it's been working hard.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Then I want to use the color of working hard.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yellow's great too! It turns Felitubby into a tiny sun.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: (Draws intently with crayons)

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Do I have to stay in the lines?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You can go outside just a little bit. Felitubby will get bored if we're too neat.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah, I used to draw it real neat, but Dr. Li said it's like Felitubby's going to work.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Hah, I won't be so neat, then. I don't wanna go to work.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Going to work is actually kinda fun.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's hard, though. I often hurt myself and the others when I wasn't good.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'm getting pretty good at work, though.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Work? You? You look about the same age as me. Work should be for grown-ups.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: My mom and dad have to go to work, so they can't stay with me in the ward.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Why are you drawing these thick clothes for Felitubby?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's a protective suit. Sometimes I have to wear thick clothes when I go on missions. Felitubby won't get hurt if he wears thick clothes.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: What do I do with this? I drew a big hat for this Felitubby, but I don't think the hat will protect him.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Well... he doesn't have to go on a mission. He can draw pictures in front of a desk.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Every day?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Every day. He'll draw whatever he wants.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: I'll draw lots of colors for him.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: People who are sitting and writing or drawing look more important.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: My mom and dad sit in front of a desk all day.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh yeah, Miss Orchid is like that. The folks at Medical also sit in front of a desk every day to write reports.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah, people who sit in front of a desk are important.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Elwin, there you are. The other doctors told me you snuck out again.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Oops, they found me.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Oh... so you've been coloring with Popukar here.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: It looks nice.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: This is... a Felitubby in a protective suit?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yes! Felitubby's going on a mission. He's really important.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: This Felitubby sits in front of a desk all day drawing. He's really important too.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Sits in front of a desk all day...?

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Yes, Popukar says that people who sit in front of a desk writing and drawing are important.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Like my mom and dad, and the doctors and nurses here, and, and—

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: And Miss Orchid, and the others!

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Can I borrow this page? I'll save it for you.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: You're confiscating it?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: No, saving it for you. That way, you can look at it anytime you want to.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Like Rhodes Island's filing cabinets?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Something like that.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Our drawing is awesome, Elwin! Rhodes Island's filing cabinets are awesome too.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Mm... okay.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Now it's time to go back, Elwin. You've been outside for a long time today.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Can I come and play again next time?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Well, it depends on whether you're a good boy in your blood check, which you need to go to now.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: I'll be good!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Bye, Popukar! See you next time!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: There's still a lot of the coloring book left.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm... I'll wait until next time Elwin's here. Lemme do my homework now.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Your squad always wears proper protection when you're in the field, right?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The scratch on Popukar's arm...

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Just a small scratch, no sign of infection. Don't worry.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: A tactical error. My fault.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: You're doing good work.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: The medical results are in. Not much change in the data compared to last time.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Still no significant drop in the cell assimilation rate... the suppressant is working, but there's no real improvement.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I stopped hoping for improvement a long time ago.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: At her age, and based on where she started, though... the status quo is good news enough.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: You'll be the one to tell her again?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Just the general gist. I don't think she should know the details.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I don't want to give a little girl a health report and ask her to consider how long she has to live.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Do you think she has a chance to make it long enough for a breakthrough discovery?

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: A 'chance' should not be how a doctor makes her bread.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: But this is what we're fighting for every day, here at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sometimes I wonder, is it better to be like Popukar, to contract Oripathy at a young age...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Or to be like me and the others, to contract the illness after we've lived our lives for a while.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...It's better to not get it at all, of course.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Heh... of course.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Would I have lived more freely and worried less, if I got infected at Popukar's age?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But the fact is, children like her live under so many restrictions once they catch the illness...

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Limitations placed upon them by adults.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: We tell them how they must not do this, how they must be careful of that.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Not to mention she still has to go on missions.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That's why I want her to live like a normal child outside of missions, to do normal things in a normal home.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: After all, going on missions and understanding these restrictions are two different things.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: All she needs to know is where to go, what to do, and that she'll be taken care of when she comes back. All she needs to be is a little bit more independent, on top of these things.

steps.name: Dr. Li
steps.text: Yes. The rest is our job.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (I was going to ask Dr. Li how long I need to press the cotton ball against my arm.)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (I'll ask another doctor. I should remember these things.)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (I'll keep it pressed for a little longer.)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think the bleeding's stopped.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I should throw the cotton ball into...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: There, the medical trash bin.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I wonder if Miss Orchid is done with Dr. Li. I'll wait for her here.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I should finish writing the mission report.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'll draw Miss Orchid, then Mr. Spot... he's raising his shield...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm, that's a little too round. Let's do this again...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then a bunch of scary-looking bandits.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Mr. Midnight did this and this, then Miss Catapult did this and this, and the bandits went POW!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: How do you draw someone flying off their feet?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Miss Catapult went boom boom boom... and then the mission was done, and everybody's happy. I'll draw some smiles.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Mr. Midnight was complaining about how hot the desert was. I'll draw some sweat on his face.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Should I draw how my arm got hurt?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I'll do that, then draw a Popukar wearing a thick protective suit on the side... and brum brum brrrrr spinning real fast.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That means I won't get hurt again!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Alright, report's finished...

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Popukar! There you are.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Elwin? Did you sneak out of the ward again?

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: No! I got permission to come out for a little while today.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: I'm done with all my checks today, so I told the doctor I wanted to play with you, and they let me come to the game room.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You completed a mission! That means you're all grown up.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: What are you drawing? A new coloring book?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: It's the report that I have to write after a field mission.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Field mission? What's that?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Going out to fight bad guys.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Oh, the 'work' that you were talking about!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: You fight bad guys? You're awesome.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Did you draw how you were fighting them? Wow, you have a big saw!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah, brum brum brrrrr is awesome too!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: So this is a 'report'? I want to draw a report too.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You wanna do it? A report is recording everything that happened that day. It's really easy.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Lemme get you a piece of paper... here, this is your report. Draw the things you did today.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: But all I did was get needles in me in the ward, then they let me come and play for a while.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You can draw that too.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Is that a mission?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think it is. The doctors told you to do something, and you did it. That's a mission.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Did you do what they told you?

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: ...A little.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then draw a little.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: (Scribbles seriously)

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: But the only thing in the report is me lying on the bed getting dripped.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: How about I draw how I sneaked out of the ward the last time?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: You can't draw yourself sneaking out!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But... I guess you got caught anyway.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Alright, then draw it smaller, like really tiny.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Would that be okay?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah, you can pretend it's not so bad if people can't see it well.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Hah, you're smart.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: I want to be like you, going to work and fighting bad guys here.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then you need to get better, and be really strong like me... or smart like Miss Orchid, or have a big shield like Mr. Spot.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But only if the doctors say it's okay.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then you can write lots of reports.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But it's okay to think about it now.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Can I write it in the report, even if I'm just thinking about it?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think it's okay. You can draw what you did today, and what you want to do.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That way, you'll know you were thinking about these things when you look at it in the future, and you won't forget.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I often draw everyone in A6 standing together and smiling happily, although what actually happens is that Miss Catapult is usually being scolded by Miss Orchid.
The boy in the patient's gown gazes at the blank sheet in front of him, then draws a small dot in a corner.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: This is the 'future'.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So small?

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Because I don't know how big it's gonna be, so I'll draw it smaller at first. That way, there'll be plenty of room for 'future' to grow bigger.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Then I'll draw a 'future' too.
Popukar draws a small dot in a corner of her completed report, then adds four small dots around it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: This way, my 'future' will grow too.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: And the futures of Orchid, Catapult, Spot, and Midnight.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Sometimes they frown when they're reading the reports, sometimes they smile. Maybe they're thinking about the future too.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Will you draw them frowning?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yes, but smaller. If you draw the sad things too big, they'll frown even more when they see it. That's not good.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: When mom and dad came to see me, they brought a lot of folders, and they were frowning at those papers.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: But they never tell me what's on the paper.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That means they put sad things on paper like the doctors here, and put them inside the door, so that we only see the things that are nice.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Don't you get mad that they don't tell you the truth?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: I think they still tell us the truth, but just the parts about what to do today, and what to do tomorrow.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: What about all the stuff that's left?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Those are reports for the grown-ups.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Grown-ups have grown-up reports. They have to write a lot of stuff about the future. Kids have kid reports, and we only have to write about today, and a little bit about the future.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: That seems so hard... I don't understand.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Mom and dad say that once I get out of hospital, we may have to move house and go to a new school. They're always planning a bunch of things that I don't understand, and I don't dare ask.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: But you look like you know what you're doing more.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Because I peeked.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Not the paper, but the faces of the grown-ups. They frown and sigh when they read the reports, but when I walk into the room, they smile and tell me Popukar has been a good girl today.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Yeah, that's what my mom and dad do.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: So I thought... they already frowned enough inside the door. Outside the door, I want to draw things that make them smile.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Like what you just drew?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah. That way, when they look at my reports, they see that I completed my mission today, and I did my homework, and smiled and laugh with the others.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Are we drawing the future so that the grown-ups will be happy?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: That's half of it.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: The other half is so that, when the future actually comes, I can tell it, 'See? I left a place for you.'

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: That sounds so cool! I need to remember that.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: When I'm as awesome as you and I can lift a big saw like you, I want to work here and say cool stuff like you, except I'll be even cooler!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: And I'll be all grown up. Maybe I'm even helping Miss Orchid make clothes!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Miss Orchid's always cutting cloth with tiny scissors. Maybe brum brum brrrrr can make lots of clothes in one spin!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Then I wanna draw more good things for them.

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: That way, when they look at my report, they'll see that today wasn't so bad.
The boy draws a ring of color around the 'future' on his sheet of paper, like a faint halo.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Popukar? Are you there?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Oh, it's Miss Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Didn't I tell you to wait for me outside the infirmary? What are you doing in the game room?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Whisper) Oh no, I forgot.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: But I finished my report here!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Popukar taught me how to write reports. We drew a lot of 'futures'!

steps.name: Elwin
steps.text: Oh, I think I have to go back to the ward now. We'll play together again next time, Popukar!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Sure! We'll write reports together again.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Reports about the future...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Alright, you've written your report, time to shower and go to bed.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Otherwise, you won't have the strength to draw a new report tomorrow.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Okay—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And get up earlier tomorrow, so I can take your measurements.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I happen to have some time on my hands, so I thought I would make you some new clothes. You want to work on them together?

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Yeah!
